enGB:
A guardian spirit is an exemplar of protection and defense.
Spirit Bonus: When you channel a guardian, your spirit bonus applies to AC, CMD, Constitution checks, Fortitude saves, Reflex saves, and the number of attacks of opportunity you can make per round.
Seance Boon: You gain a +1 bonus to CMD.
Influence Penalty: Because of your focus on defense, you take a penalty on damage rolls equal to your spirit bonus.
Guardian’s Shield (Lesser, Su): You gain proficiency in heavy armors and shields (including tower shields). In addition, you gain a free-action persistent toggle: party members and animal companions within 5 + 5 × floor(spirit bonus / 2) feet take half damage from any source, with the halved portion redirected to you.
Absorb Blow (Intermediate, Su): You gain DR/— and resistance to acid, cold, electricity, fire, and sonic equal to 1/2 your medium level. Add Bestow Grace to your medium spells known as a 2nd-level spell.
Guardian's Determination (Greater, Su): By spending a full-round action or accepting 1 point of influence as a free action, you increase your threat range by 5 + (spirit bonus - 1) × 5 feet until the start of your next turn and can teleport into weapon reach to make attacks of opportunity within that range.
Legendary Guardian (Supreme, Su): Medium's Charisma inspires her allies so much that even when their hit points drop below 0 they continue to fight, even though they are still considered dead (or unconscious) for all effects and can be cured by Breath of Life or similar Spells as per spell description. After the encounter or upon receiving a number of attacks equal to Medium's Charisma modifier allies in this state fall dead (or unconscious). If all of the Medium's allies die that way, she becomes fully drained and dies.
zhCN:
守护者英灵是保护与防御的典范。
英灵同调：降灵守护者时，你的英灵同调适用于防御等级（AC）、战技防御（CMD）、体质检定、强韧豁免、反射豁免，以及每轮可以进行的借机攻击次数。
降灵奖励：你的战技防御（CMD）获得+1加值。
共鸣惩罚：由于过度专注防御，你的伤害掷骰承受等同于英灵同调的减值。
守护者坚盾（次级，超自然）：你擅长重甲和盾牌（包括塔盾）。此外，你获得一个自由动作持久开关：位于你「5＋5×(英灵同调加值/2，向下取整)」尺范围内的队伍成员与动物伙伴所受到的任何伤害减半，被减半的部分由你代为承受。
吸收冲击（中等，超自然）：你获得等同于通灵者等级1/2的伤害减免（DR/—），以及等量的强酸、寒冷、电击、火焰和音波抗力。将恩典（游戏内称“施恩”）作为2环法术加入你的通灵者已知法术。
守护者决心（高等，超自然）：通过花费一个整轮动作，或者以自由动作让守护者对你的共鸣增加1点，你可以将你的威胁范围提升「5＋(英灵同调加值−1)×5」尺，持续至你的下一回合开始；当引发借机攻击的目标不在你的实际武器触及内时，你可以瞬移到该敌人附近将其纳入你的触及范围内并执行借机攻击。
传奇守护者（至高，超自然）：通灵者的魅力极大地鼓舞盟友，使他们即使生命值降至0以下也能继续战斗。不过，在所有效果的判定中，他们仍视为死亡（或昏迷），并可以按法术说明接受生命之息或类似法术的治疗。战斗结束后，或承受的攻击次数达到通灵者的魅力调整值后，处于此状态的盟友会倒下并死亡（或昏迷）。如果通灵者的所有盟友都以这种方式死亡，通灵者也会耗尽力量而死。
